entry.title: A liability rule aimed at the wrong control: what the law offers when a delegate exceeds its instruction

category.term: The Drift Layer, paper no. 5 — Version 1

entry.summary: A reading of Part 7 of the Payment Services Regulations 2017 and of the common-law ledger, applied to a payment executed by a software delegate under a standing instruction: which provisions can and cannot reach the case where the close is outside the description the payer gave.

entry.title: The Drift Layer: the clean, fast session that is not proof of authority

category.term: The Drift Layer, paper no. 4 — Version 1

entry.summary: Merchant-side friction models lean on proxies for a human nervous system: hesitation, mouse movement, repeated clicks, typos, abandonment. What those signals are worth when there is no nervous system behind the session.

entry.title: Four Measures for Mandate Conformance
entry.summary: Evaluation coverage, mandate conformance, divergence incidence, and unauthorised continuation. Coverage is reported first. The definitions are free and citable, and stay that way.
